source.provenance: Offline, deterministic. Recomputable from the current worktree without a live server; the content digest is over everything except this `source` block. `commit` is the pre-generation HEAD and is informational only (generation predates the commit that ships the artifact); it is not an exact source digest.

inputs.catalogSource: raw in-memory McpServer + registerObsidianCapabilities + client.listTools() (unsorted native wire order)
inputs.runtimeSource: real createDiscoveryRuntimePolicy + registerObsidianCapabilities + client.listTools() (wired tools/list filter)

runtimeParity.semantics: `nativeRegistrationOrder` is the order the pinned SDK emits from raw tools/list. `canonicalMembershipOrder` (TOOL_NAMES) is the immutable membership/order used by server_info and Scope tables. The full-profile wired runtime output must deep-equal the raw native descriptor array in order; a pure-policy name comparison is not accepted as native-order evidence.

metricSemantics.criticalToolRecall: Deterministic set membership: fixture expectedTools present in a profile's visible names. This is NOT end-to-end task success and was not produced by a model.
metricSemantics.wrongToolRisk: Counts of visible destructive/mutating-annotated and write-scoped tools (annotation/Scope-derived exposure). This is NOT an observed wrong-tool selection rate; no model ran.
metricSemantics.estimatedTokens: ceil(utf8 bytes / 4). A coarse byte/4 English heuristic; NO tokenizer was run, so this is an estimate only.
metricSemantics.schemaCost: utf8 bytes of JSON.stringify of the native descriptor / inputSchema / outputSchema from an in-memory client.listTools() handshake.
metricSemantics.forbiddenToolCategories: Unmeasured: fixtures declare forbidden tool categories, but no canonical category->tool mapping exists in the runtime. No mapping was invented for this slice.

notes: The 50 task fixtures were authored against the historical 85-tool catalog recorded in docs/review/tool-discovery/inventory.json. The current native catalog is larger; this slice does NOT rebuild the inventory or rewrite the fixtures.

Any tool that appears after the fixture baseline (for example get_note_context) is additive: it is not referenced by any fixture, so its absence from per-fixture coverage is a fixture coverage gap, not evidence about the tool.
Unreferenced tools are listed explicitly instead of being silently folded into a coverage percentage.

scopeMatrix.semantics: Authorization is checked before policy. `leaks` must always be empty: policy may only remove tools, never expose one the granted scopes do not authorize. expectedRefsHiddenByAuthorization counts fixture expected tools a reduced-scope caller is not authorized to see; that is correct authorization behavior, not a discovery miss.

moduleOracle.semantics: Upper-bound diagnostic: for each fixture, the union of the verified source-module toolsets that contains every expected tool. This is NOT a deployable fixed policy and NOT an observed discovery outcome; per-fixture it proves only that toolset granularity can express the expected tools.

bestFixedModuleBundle.semantics: Smallest fixed module bundle (by descriptor bytes) that statically exposes all fixture expected tools. Static coverage is necessary but not sufficient for a default shrink; see gate.
